Counter final class

Demo Model — a counter you can drive with ↑ / ↓ and quit with q, Esc, or Ctrl+C (all three are pinned in the matrix — the frame's hint line names the three exit mechanisms, not the matching rule: lowercase q under any modifier except ctrl, Esc under any modifier, and Ctrl+C — the rune-exact gap is the teaching surface the shouldQuit() comment and CounterTest spell out).
